behaviors.description: Install and replace an app from independently exported OCI images.
behaviors.preconditions: Installed dependency runtime and independent A/B OCI images with exported payload bytes.
behaviors.expected: Explicit image selection deploys exact app payloads and preserves runtime/origin across replacement; forcing image parsing on an unsupported transport produces an image-specific rejection rather than ordinary ref parsing.

behaviors.description: Install from a sideload repository while remote payloads are unavailable.
behaviors.preconditions: Signed collection remote, installed runtime, absent app and independently prepared app-only sideload repository.
behaviors.expected: Ordinary install attempts a blocked payload transfer and leaves the app absent; the sideload option installs its exact commit without remote payload requests.

mappings.rationale: Independent payload bytes, exact ref membership and origin persistence validate actual image deployment.

surface_assertions.rationale: Explicit image parsing rejects an unsupported transport differently from ordinary ref parsing; valid image inputs deploy independently prepared A/B payloads.

mappings.rationale: A real blocked-download control distinguishes local sideload data from cached or remotely downloaded payloads.

surface_assertions.rationale: Installation succeeds at the exact signed commit without remote payload transfers only when the local source is supplied.
